decisive_spans.text: An abdominal ultrasound demonstrated a cystic lesion in the head of the pancreas. Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen confirmed a well-circumscribed, 11.8 cm cystic mass in the pancreatic head

response.rationale: The vignette describes a well-circumscribed cystic mass in the pancreatic head, which is a strong indicator for Serous cystadenoma. While thrombocytosis is present, it is not directly related to the pancreatic mass and is treated as a separate finding.
